decisions.reason: The power-chain clarification does not change the separate signal connector or its pinout.
The source does not change I2C cable, pull-up, speed, or series-resistor requirements.
The interboard power topology and INA219 placement do not alter any GPIO assignment.
The source does not change the USB data lines or native USB programming interface.
A same-message MODIFY already records the INA219 placement and total downstream 3.3V measurement coverage completely.
The source does not change the panel reset connector, mounting, or electrical action.
The interboard power-routing clarification does not change the charge-status LED circuit or connector.
The three-board architecture and existing board roles remain valid; the source adds interboard power-interface detail owned by the source Requirement rather than changing the architecture variant.
The source describes normal interboard power distribution and INA219 coverage without changing the standalone USB power source, activation condition, or powered loads.
The source does not change any panel button, switch, GPIO, or connector requirement.
Mention of downstream sensor-board power does not change the PIR input connector requirement.
The source specifically establishes the 3.3V monitoring path and does not change the switched 5V rail's control, loads, or operating policy.
